info.title: Agricultural Ingestion, 3-Year Plan Optimization & Gemini Advisory API
info.description: Standardized agricultural ingestion and multi-objective 3-year planting plan solver. Ingests raw NASA Earth observations, dated in-situ sensors, elevation maps, and input prices. Simulates year-by-year physical ground impact (NPK balances, Henin-Dupuis SOC %, ASAE compaction PSI, FAO-56 ETc deficits, RUSLE erosion) and generates 5 distinct farmer strategies: Most Income, Best Soil Health, Least Effort, Highest ROI %, and Least Risk, accompanied by grounded Google Gemini 3.8 Flash AI advisory.

post.description:
Ingest, validate, harmonize units, and produce a normalized field profile.
Processes:
- Parcel Info & Baseline Soil Type
- Flexible 1-5 Past Harvest Records
- Seed Data: Greenhouse Need ('Open Field Only', 'Greenhouse Required', etc.) &
  Resistances to Extreme Events (Drought, Flood, High Wind, Frost, Heat)
- Economic Input Prices (Diesel, Water, Electricity, NPK, Labor)
- NASA Earth Observations (11 datasets)
- Optional Long Term Climate Projections
- Local User Data (In-Situ sensors & Soil override)
- Elevation Maps (DEM, slope, aspect, waterlogging)

Lightweight validation endpoint checking payload structure, soil type resolution,
greenhouse suitability, extreme weather resilience, and data completeness score.

post.summary: Generate 5 Distinct 3-Year Planting Plans with Soil Dynamics and Gemini Advisory
post.description:
Ingests multi-domain field data (NASA POWER daily timeseries, GPM IMERG rainfall, SMAP moisture,
OpenET, SoilGrids, In-Situ Sensors, Elevation Maps, and Input Prices).
Simulates year-by-year physical ground impact (NPK balances, Henin-Dupuis SOC %, ASAE compaction PSI,
FAO-56 ETc water deficits, RUSLE erosion).
Outputs 5 distinct strategies for the farmer to choose from:
1. **Most Income**
2. **Best Soil Health**
3. **Least Effort / Labour**
4. **Highest ROI (%)**
5. **Least Amount of Crop Loss Risk**
Includes grounded Google Gemini 3.8 Flash AI advisory with deterministic offline fallback.

FullFieldIngestionPayload.title: FullFieldIngestionPayload
FullFieldIngestionPayload.description:
Unified Ingestion Payload accepted by the Input Parser API.
Encompasses all core agronomic domains:
- Parcel Info (with Soil Type)
- Last couple years harvest/crop info (1-5 flexible)
- Seed / Water / Oil Prices (with Greenhouse need & Extreme Event resistance inside seed data)
- NASA data (Official raw database responses & full dated daily/scene timeseries)
- Long Term Weather Projections (optional)
- Local User Data (with dated in-situ sensor readings & soil type override)
- Elevation Maps
